root.description: The id of the root the path is under

path.description: The declaring member's package.json, relative to its root

name.description: The dependency's key in that field

range.description: The range as written, or for `catalog` the range the catalog resolves it to (as written when no catalog entry resolves it)

targetPath.description: The package.json of the member it links, or null when it links no member this run can name: a registry package, a range the manager does not link, or a name no member with rows carries (a WORKSPACE_TARGET_UNKNOWN condition marks the ones a member with no rows could be)

protocol.description: `workspace`: a `workspace:` range, linked by name or (pnpm) by relative path; `catalog`: a `catalog:` range (pnpm, or bun from the root package.json), `range` holding what the catalog resolves it to; `link` and `file`: a local path, linked when it is a member's directory; `npm`: anything else, a registry range linked only by the package manager's rule for a plain range

projection-workspace-dependencies.description: A row of the derived `workspace_dependencies` relation
